description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeMembershipDao component of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It contains unit tests verifying CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee memberships, utilizing mock data and assertions to ensure DAO correctness.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeMembershipDao operations in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, testing retrieval, deletion, search, save, and update of employee memberships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and loads test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Verifies retrieving an employee membership by ID returns correct data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple employee memberships by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Checks search functionality returns correct number and type of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new employee membership record.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee membership record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of search results matches expected.
